_doc: Commands that must go through devctl so sessions never fight over a device or kill each other's apps.

rules.message: Devices, emulators and heavy builds are shared between sessions through the devctl ledger. Run `devctl status` first, then `devctl run <device> [flutter run args]`, `devctl exec <device> -- <cmd>`, `devctl build -- <cmd>` or `devctl emu <avd>`. If another session owns the device, `devctl wait <device> "purpose"`; when done, `devctl release <device>`. Never kill other sessions' apps or emulators (pkill etc.).
